profile.field.name: Name
ai.unavailable: No AI translation profile is configured.
surface.title: Translate
input.placeholder: Type or paste text to translate...
status.waiting: Translation starts automatically when you pause typing.
status.error: Translation failed: {message}. Retry or check Settings.
status.settingsPaused: Translation paused after opening AI settings. Retry or edit the text to translate.
ai.settingsOpenFailed: Could not open app AI settings. Try again.
toast.continueFailed: Could not return to Launcher. Try again or copy the translation.
status.stopped: Stopped. Preview is incomplete. Retry or edit the text.
error.ai.incomplete: The AI stream ended before completion
status.noProfile: No enabled profile. Enable a translation profile in Settings.
ai.readiness.checking: Checking provider and model configuration… Translation text and terms are not sent.
ai.readiness.scope: Quota and request success are determined when the translation runs.
ai.readiness.provider_not_configured: No system AI provider is selected. Select a provider here or in the app’s AI settings.
ai.readiness.provider_not_registered: The selected provider is no longer registered. Choose an available provider in Settings.
ai.readiness.provider_login_required: This provider needs sign-in. Check its account in the app’s AI settings, then check again.
ai.readiness.desktop_required: This provider requires the desktop app. Open it there and check again.
ai.readiness.cli_missing: The provider’s command-line tool was not found. Check its installation in the app’s AI settings.
ai.readiness.metadata_unavailable: Provider details could not be checked. Check the app’s AI settings or try checking again. An explicit provider and model can still be tried.
ai.readiness.metadata_timeout: The configuration check timed out. Check again. An explicit provider and model can still be tried.
ai.readiness.model_catalog_unknown: The model list is unknown. Check again or try an explicitly selected provider and model.
ai.readiness.model_catalog_incomplete: The model list is incomplete. The saved model is retained; an explicit selection can still be tried.
ai.readiness.model_catalog_fallback: Only a fallback model list is available. Availability is unverified; an explicit selection can still be tried.
ai.readiness.agent_unknown: The selected model could not be confirmed. Choose a model in Settings or check again.
ai.readiness.capability_unavailable: This provider or model does not support text generation. Choose a compatible model in Settings.
ai.readiness.input_unavailable: This model does not support text input. Choose a compatible model in Settings.
ai.readiness.configuration_changed: AI configuration changed during the check. Check again before translating.
ai.readiness.permission_denied: AI access is not allowed for this plugin. Enable its AI permission in Settings, then check again.
ai.readiness.legacy_host: This host cannot check AI configuration. An explicit provider and model can still be tried.
ai.readiness.selection_required: The inherited provider or model cannot be confirmed. Select both explicitly in Settings before translating.
error.ai.selection: Choose an explicit AI provider and model in Settings
ai.glossary.title: Translation terms
ai.glossary.description: Choose preferred wording for source terms in one target language. Use the same text on both sides to keep a name unchanged.
ai.glossary.privacy: Applicable terms are sent with your text to the selected AI provider; the model may not follow every preference.
ai.glossary.limits: Up to 20 terms, with 80 characters per field.
ai.glossary.draftHint: Edits stay local until you save. Switching profiles or closing this dialog discards unsaved edits.
ai.glossary.saveFailed: Could not save terms. Your edits are still here; try saving again.
ai.glossary.clearFailed: Could not clear saved terms. Your edits are still here; try again.
ai.glossary.changed: Saved terms changed while you were editing. Discard edits to load them, or save to replace them with this draft.
ai.glossary.invalidSaved: Saved terms are invalid. Fix or clear them in Translation settings before trying again.
ai.glossary.applies: Saved terms will be sent for {language} translations.
ai.glossary.notApplied: Saved terms apply to {language}; they will not be sent for this target language.
ai.glossary.error.shape: The terms have an invalid format. Review both fields in each row, or clear saved terms and enter them again.
ai.glossary.error.language: Choose a specific target language for these terms.
ai.glossary.error.entries: Keep at most 20 terms. Remove extra rows before saving.
ai.glossary.error.empty: Row {row}: enter both a source term and preferred wording, or remove this row.
ai.glossary.error.characters: Row {row}: shorten each field to at most 80 characters.
ai.glossary.error.control: Row {row}: remove line breaks or control characters from the term.
ai.glossary.error.duplicate: Row {row}: this source term is already listed. Remove the duplicate row.
ai.glossary.error.conflict: Row {row}: this source term has different preferred wording in another row. Keep one version.
ai.glossary.error.bytes: There is too much term content. Shorten or remove some entries before saving.
